name: Canadian Rocky Mountains

geo.extent: Alberta–British Columbia boundary from the US border to the Liard River

description: The eastern ranges of the Cordillera along the Alberta–British Columbia boundary: high limestone and quartzite peaks, glaciers and icefields, broad glacial valleys (Bow, Athabasca) and the highest summits of Alberta. Mount Robson (3,954 m, BC) is the highest peak of the Canadian Rockies in the table; Mount Columbia (3,747 m) is Alberta's highest point. The mountain national parks (Banff, Jasper, Yoho, Kootenay) are here.

notable_heights.name: Mount Columbia (AB–BC boundary; highest point of Alberta)
